title: Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar
identity_notes: CBS detective drama centered on freelance insurance investigator Johnny Dollar. GRH also preserves pre-series/role audition material, including Dick Powell (1948), John Lund daily-serial audition material (1952), and Gerald Mohr (1955). Specialist logs place episode 1 on 1949-02-11; some secondary references cite 1949-02-18 as the premiere, so the alternate convention is preserved in evidence notes.

eras.label: Charles Russell era
eras.notes: Initial CBS series run; sustaining for most of this period.

eras.label: Edmond O'Brien era
eras.notes: CBS weekly run; Wrigley sponsorship begins during this era.

eras.label: John Lund era
eras.notes: CBS weekly run; Wrigley sponsorship prominent.

eras.label: Bob Bailey five-part serial era
eras.notes: CBS sustaining weekday serial, normally five 15-minute installments per story.

eras.label: Bob Bailey weekly era
eras.notes: Returned to weekly half-hour form; final Bailey broadcast also marks end of Hollywood run.

eras.label: Robert Readick New York era
eras.notes: New York production run after Hollywood production ended.

eras.label: Mandel Kramer final era
eras.notes: Final CBS era through The Tip-Off Matter.

historical_context.title: Network radio drama during the television transition
historical_context.description: Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar continued through the period when U.S. network dramatic radio contracted as television became dominant; secondary radio histories identify it among the last long-running network dramatic series.

historical_context.title: CBS package-program strategy
historical_context.description: CBS developed and sold network-owned package programs as part of its postwar radio strategy; contemporary-history synthesis identifies Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar as one of the durable CBS packages.
